remarks: Nestled in the heart of Silvermine, this unique storybook-style riverfront retreat blends timeless antique charm with serene natural surroundings. Spanning three levels, the home features 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, highlighted by wide plank floors, bay windows, and a cozy fireplace that adds warmth and character throughout. Step outside to multiple newly built decks overlooking the river, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, while the outdoor fire pit creates an inviting setting surrounded by nature. Additional amenities include a dedicated laundry room and seamless indoor/outdoor living spaces. A rare opportunity to enjoy the beauty, charm, and tranquility of this one-of-a-kind Silvermine gem. Please schedule your private viewing before it's gone!
